title: Canvas Op
description: One persisted collaboration operation on a live canvas (plans/99-canvas-op-contract.md). Mirrors the CanvasOp discriminated union in packages/core/src/canvas-op-v1.ts field-for-field - keep the two in sync by hand; there is no schema-from-types generator here. A discriminated union on `k`, expressed as allOf/if-then (not oneOf) so each branch is its own fully-closed (`additionalProperties: false`) object rather than an ambiguous alternative list. Every op carries `origin` - the Lamport-clock + client-id stamp the reference CRDT (ReferenceCanvasDoc) orders by; lolly-work's real Yjs adapter may ignore it. v1.1 (plans/100 section 3, additive): every box op takes an optional `col` (blocks-input collection scoping - never `param`, whose lane is collection-blind), and the presence $def gains focus/location/following/viewport/chat.

k.description: The op kind. Deliberately small and append-only (plans/99 section 9) - geometry/field/structural/order, plus `param` for the params document lane (plans/99 section 6).

then.description: Set a subset of geometry fields on one box - the geometry lane (plans/99 section 4.1 `moved`). Never invalidates a raster/tile (plans/99 section 4.3).

fields.description: At least one geometry field to set. Field NAMES are the shipped defaults (x,y,w,h,rot); a tool with renamed BoxFieldConfig roles must resolve to these before crossing the seam.

then.description: Set one content field on one box - the content lane (plans/99 section 4.1 `restyled`). `frame`/`group`/`order` membership are ordinary field writes too (plans/99 section 3).
Insert a new box with its full row + a paint-order key (plans/99 section 4.1 `added`).

row.description: The box's flat row of fields - a BoxRow. Every value is a Scalar; file bytes, live frames, and unresolved bindings never enter an op (plans/99 section 7).

orderKey.description: LWW fractional-index paint-order key (see ReferenceCanvasDoc). lolly-work's adapter uses Y.Array<BoxId> instead - documented order-model divergence (plans/99 section 3, section 8).

then.description: Delete a box (plans/99 section 4.1 `removed`). The id is never reused.
Set a box's paint-order key (plans/99 section 4.1 `zChanged`, order move).
Set a `params` entry - a separate document lane (`Y.Map<CanonicalId, ParamValue>`), not a box field (plans/99 section 6).

origin.description: The Lamport-clock + client-id stamp every op carries (plans/99 section 8). Higher `clock` wins the LWW merge; on a tie, the higher `client` id wins.

client.description: Client id - also the LWW tiebreak on equal clock.

boxId.description: A stable, client-generated ULID (plans/99 section 2). Everything keys on this, never an array index.

collectionId.description: v1.1 (plans/100 section 3): the blocks-input collection an op targets; absent = the default canvas collection, so every v1.0 op stays valid. Never on `param` - the params lane is collection-blind.

scalar.description: The CRDT-syncable value of a single box field (plans/99 section 7). Deliberately narrow - no file bytes, no live frames.

providerRef.description: A descriptor of WHICH dataset/query a binding reads - never the resolved datum (plans/99 section 6).

version.description: Optionally pins the provider so a schema change doesn't silently re-resolve differently across clients (plans/99 section 11).

paramBinding.description: A param binding syncs as a descriptor, never the resolved datum - live data does not travel through the CRDT (plans/99 section 6).

paramValue.description: The reactive/data-bus value stored per canonical id in `params` (plans/99 section 3, section 6): either a literal scalar or a binding descriptor.

presence.title: Awareness / Presence
presence.description: Ephemeral presence - the Yjs awareness channel, NEVER written to the doc (plans/99 section 5). Carries no origin/clock: it is not an op and never converges. Broadcast at pointer-move rate. v1.1 (plans/100 section 3, section 4) adds focus/location/following/viewport/chat - all optional, all still never persisted.

cursor.description: Normalized 0..1 of the design's unit space, so every zoom level and every presenter renders it identically (plans/99 section 5).

drag.description: In-flight drag delta (also normalized unit space) - never persisted.

focus.description: v1.1 (plans/100 section 3, section 4.1): the focused input - an input id, or "<blocksId>:<rowId>" for a blocks row. Drives the focus-ring presence primitive on every tool.

location.description: v1.1 (plans/100 section 4.2): which slide/page/scene the user is on (big tools) - presence-bar grouping and the follow-mode target.

following.description: v1.1 (plans/100 section 4.2): the userId this user is following - follow is a pure presence field, never a mode.

chat.description: v1.1 (plans/100 section 3): cursor chat - max 64 chars, rides the awareness channel only, never persisted.
